fixed_tape_investigation.comparison: previous patched-cueq publication cell versus fresh FP32 cell
fixed_tape_investigation.conclusion: Changed native inputs or random draws do not explain the residual change. Execution/compiler/kernel variation remains a hypothesis, not an isolated root cause.
fixed_tape_investigation.repeat_conclusion: Cross-process FoldJAX output variability persists with exactly equal realized inputs and the same frozen RNG tape. No unique compiler or kernel root cause has been established. Do not report only the smallest residual.
